entities.name: Jenner's Smallpox Vaccination

entities.summary: Edward Jenner inoculated 8-year-old James Phipps with cowpox pus from milkmaid Sarah Nelmes, then challenged with smallpox. The boy was immune. Published An Inquiry (1798).
